svg.title: An image becomes a table of pixels
svg.desc: A five by five grayscale image. Pixel x four, y one has brightness one hundred eighty, and an arrow connects it to the matching table row. The center pixel, x two, y two, is missing and its table brightness is a question mark. The table shows three of twenty-five rows.
svg.text: An image is a table of pixels
Each pixel becomes one row. Its position is known; its brightness may be missing.
The missing pixel keeps its x and y.
